artist.name: Chelsea Cutler
artist.short_description: American singer-songwriter and producer whose pop catalogue combines relationship writing with electronic and acoustic textures.
artist.biography: Chelsea Cutler is an American singer-songwriter and producer associated with Westport, Connecticut. Her solo catalogue blends intimate songwriting with elements of electronic pop, an editorial description of the way her releases have developed across several years. She emerged with early releases including 'Your Shirt' and the 2017 'Snow in October' project, then built a larger audience through the 'Sleeping with Roses' releases. Her first full-length album, 'How to Be Human,' arrived in 2020 and was followed by 'When I Close My Eyes' in 2021. She has also worked with Jeremy Zucker, a collaboration that sits alongside rather than replacing her solo work. The 2023 album 'Stellaria' marked an especially reflective chapter. In an interview with the Recording Academy, Cutler described valuing presence, openness, and vulnerability during its creation. She explained that 'you're all i ever dreamed of' revisited the early, delicate period of a personal relationship, while 'Your Bones' came from a melody that arrived unexpectedly in a voice note. In September 2026 she released 'IS THIS THE END?', extending her discography. For Afterglow, she offers a bridge from softer emotional pop toward understated electronic and singer-songwriter production. Mood and genre labels here are editorial navigation aids, not universally defined categories.
